about_the_game:
The carnival is no longer a place of laughter—it’s a hunting ground. In this demo of Carnival Hunt, you’ll step into a terrifying game of predator and prey where every sound, every move, and every second counts.

One player becomes the Carnival Monster, a relentless hunter who must feed on wind-up keys to keep going. The others play as fragile Bunnies, winding each other up to survive while desperately avoiding the monster’s grasp. Cooperation is your only hope—but even that might not be enough.

What’s inside this demo:

  • Play as Monster or Bunny – stalk your prey as the Magician, or fight to endure as one of the Bunnies.

  • Survival through teamwork – wind up your allies, share scarce keys, and outwit the monster together.

  • Suspense at every turn – hide among the dead, mislead the hunter, or risk it all to save a friend.

  • One haunting map – a procedurally shifting carnival space that keeps every round unpredictable.

  • Progression system – climb through levels as you win matches and sharpen your survival instincts.

  • Immersive multiplayer – first-person tension for everyone, with in-game positional voice chat for chillingly real coordination.

This demo delivers the core heart-pounding experience of Carnival Hunt: asymmetric survival, relentless pursuit, and terrifying unpredictability. Whether you’re the monster lurking in the shadows or a Bunny clinging to your last key, every match is a fight for your life.

The carnival is waiting. Will you survive the hunt—or become part of the silence?

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We highly recommend to have a microphone as this game depends on in-game communication.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.6GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We highly recommend to have a microphone as this game depends on in-game communication.

short_description: Carnival Hunt is a asymmetric horror strategy multiplayer game. One player takes on the role of the Carnival Monster, and the other players play as the Bunnies.
